mapper.select: select userdata_details.username || ' 送出報價單' as title from "interviewworks_schema"."userdata_details" userdata_details where userdata_details.is_active = '1' and userdata_details.is_active_notifications = '1'

select '編號(' || quotations.quotation_id || ')' || quotations.username || ' 報價單通知' as title, quotations.status as status from "interviewworks_schema"."quotations" quotations where quotations.status != 'rejected' and username = #{username}
